methods.displayName: Limestone attack stones — existing flamtaer bag

start.location: Mort'ton supply loop and POH games room
start.instruction: Use the builder shop supply loop only with the existing bag and verified access; build at the stone space in your games room.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted Construction baseline for limestone attack stones.
Own a player-owned house; currently unsupported.
Have an accessible games room stone space; currently unsupported.
Complete the hard Morytania Diary for this supply loop; currently unsupported.
Have permanently restored Razmire with serum 208; currently unsupported.
An already-owned flamtaer bag must be carried. Acquisition is outside this method; never turn its absence into routine preparation.

preparation.description: Have a usable house teleport with its supplies for the return loop; currently unsupported.
Have 20 inventory positions usable for bricks during collection, counting bricks already carried. Currently unsupported; do not require 20 extra empty slots after loading.
Have coins for the next 80-brick shop cycle at its actual stock-dependent prices; currently unsupported. This is not a session budget.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional empty-slot minimum while carrying the building batch; collection capacity requires a separate verified check.

setupItems.description: Morytania legs 3 for Burgh de Rott travel; tier 4 is not modeled as equivalent.

consumes.description: Ten loose limestone bricks for one build. Bag contents do not count as verified loose materials.

produces.basis: Per limestone attack stone built, before any outfit bonus; XP is not an inventory item.

stopConditions.description: Pause to recheck supplies below one loose batch; the bag may contain more bricks but its contents are unknown.

xpRate.assumptions: Guide supply-loop benchmark: 70,000–75,000 with mistakes, up to 80,000. Assumes the existing bag, 20 brick positions, shop access, funded resupply, house teleports and Morytania legs travel. Not a measured forecast for this account.

costs.assumptions: Neutral unestimated fixed costs. The next shop cycle needs a separate budget check; no session cost is forecast. Bag acquisition, room construction and dangerous storage transitions are outside this method. No storage-unlock score.

methods.reason: Alternative: a brick-based UIM supply loop. Boundary: already-owned bag only. Risk: Mort'ton travel is not declared safe; the bag and its contents are lost on death. No death-storage compatibility is assessed.

optionalSetup.description: Optional graceful outfit or POH run-energy pool; neither is a hard gate.
